title: Bevel (edge/vertex)
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Blender 5.2 LTS

direct_observations: Width Type has 5 variants (Offset/Width/Depth/Percent/Absolute) with different meanings for the same Width number -- this project has only ever used bmesh.ops.bevel defaults, never explicitly varied Width Type
Clamp Overlap prevents overshoot past neighboring faces; Miter Outer/Inner controls extra geometry at multi-edge corners to avoid pinching
experiments: see knowledge/foundation/operator_cards/bevel.md -- pre-existing project findings, not fresh this session

title: Bevel Modifier
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Blender 4.5 LTS Manual; reproduced in Blender 5.2.0 LTS

direct_observations: The modifier is a non-destructive alternative to the Edit Mode Bevel operation
Limit methods include None, Angle, Weight attribute, and Vertex Group
Clamp Overlap restricts bevel width but is not documented as a complete topology-quality guarantee
candidate_principles: Use Angle limiting when coplanar triangulation edges should not be beveled
Choose segment count from visual requirements because evaluated density rises quickly
Inspect minimum edge length and corner quality even when Clamp Overlap is enabled
Apply or explicitly account for non-uniform object scale before judging world-space bevel width

title: Mirror Modifier
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Accessible 4.x Manual; reproduced in Blender 5.2.0 LTS

direct_observations: The mirror plane comes from local object axes or a designated Mirror Object
Merge welds matching vertices only within Merge Distance
Clipping constrains Edit Mode movement but does not merge vertices already outside the threshold
Bisect cuts crossing geometry before mirroring
candidate_principles: Diagnose a failed seam from plane placement, transforms, vertex distance, Merge settings, and evaluated topology before raising the threshold
Treat Mirror/Subdivision order as topology-dependent and verify the evaluated seam instead of relying on a universal stack rule

title: Boolean Modifier
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Blender 5.0 Manual; reproduced in Blender 5.2.0 LTS

direct_observations: Difference subtracts source volume, Union combines volumes while removing interior faces, and Intersect retains shared volume
Fast is intended for speed but lacks robust overlapping-geometry support; Exact is slower and supports overlap/coplanarity
Manifold is usually fastest but requires manifold operands except for the documented Difference-with-plane case
Only manifold operands are guaranteed to produce proper results
candidate_principles: Inspect n-gons, degenerates, zero-length edges, shading, and editability even when a Boolean result is manifold
Avoid tangent or coincident cutter placement when a small strategy change can prevent solver slivers

title: Solidify Modifier
creator: Blender Foundation
version: Accessible Manual generations; reproduced in Blender 5.2.0 LTS

direct_observations: Thickness is calculated in local coordinates, so non-uniform object scale can vary world-space thickness
Offset places thickness relative to face normals
Fill Rim joins inner and outer boundaries
Even Thickness improves consistency but does not guarantee exact thickness for every topology
candidate_principles: Apply or explicitly account for non-uniform scale before judging wall thickness
Treat an intentionally open rim as a pipeline choice, not a closed solid

title: BMesh Operators (bmesh.ops) Python API reference
creator: Blender Foundation
version: current Blender Python API

direct_observations: grid_fill(bm, edges, mat_nr, use_smooth, use_interp_simple) has NO span/offset parameters (unlike the higher-level bpy.ops.mesh.fill_grid) -- confirmed via WebSearch cross-reference, not the truncated page alone
Official chain-link example script demonstrates bridge_loops called on edges from two independently-generated spin operations, matching the corrected reproduction in this session
Standalone BMesh ownership requires explicit write-back/free; indexed sequences require current lookup tables
Scripts are responsible for valid selection/connectivity state and explicit edit-mesh updates
